name: Creative Business
summary: Media and marketing for the creative industries, taught in project teams and assessed as much on how you work as on what you know. Its selection procedure is scored on a published points rubric across an application letter, a résumé, a study-skills questionnaire, a prior-knowledge test and an interview.

notes: A full IB Diploma is compared by Nuffic to a vwo diploma, and BUas offers a three-year track to applicants whose diploma is comparable to vwo. The standard hbo bachelor recorded on this programme is four years and 240 ECTS; the length of the short track was not established here, so it is not recorded as a credential.
